author: Rob Loach
install_msg: PyBoy installed. Have the bot owner run `[p]pyboyset download` to grab a Game Boy core, then play with `[p]pyboy` and an attached ROM.
name: PyBoy
short: Play Game Boy games in Discord
description: Play Game Boy games together in Discord. Attach a .gb or .gbc ROM (homebrew, or one you have the rights to) and control it with buttons, emulated through libretro.
